bio.text: Adam Hamawy is the Democratic candidate for New Jersey's 12th Congressional District, the seat left open by the retirement of Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman.
He is a reconstructive plastic surgeon with an office in Princeton and lives in South Brunswick.
The son of Egyptian immigrants, he was raised in Old Bridge and spent eight years as a U.S. Army officer, including nine months as a combat surgeon in Baghdad during the Iraq War.
Before this campaign he had not sought elected office.
